concerns.location: spec.md:Edge Cases 'Data Scarcity' / 'Data Not Found' / Assumptions 'Dataset Availability'
concerns.text: Same trigger conditions map to two different terminal errors. Edge case 'Data Scarcity' says <50 samples OR >80% failure halts with DATA_INSUFFICIENT; 'Data Not Found' says the same threshold terminates with DATA_NOT_FOUND; the Assumptions section says the same condition 'terminated with a DATA_NOT_FOUND report'. Pick one error code and one threshold statement for the identical condition.
Stale artifact naming: 'a `vif_report.json` (now `pls_variance_report.json`)' — the parenthetical rename is leftover revision debris. Use only `pls_variance_report.json` (consistent with FR-015).

Reaction-condition feature list is inconsistent: US-1 says '(solvent, temperature)' while FR-001 and FR-011 say '(solvent, catalyst, temperature)'. Also FR-011 says conditions are encoded 'when splitting by template', but FR-002/FR-017 make scaffold splitting the primary strategy — align the wording.
Terminology drift: SC-001 calls the second baseline 'flattened-spectrum baseline' while FR-005 and US-3 call it 'spectrum-only baseline (concatenated IR+NMR)'. Use one name.

FR-010 opens with 'MUST validate ... against an independent experimental dataset' but then permits proceeding with 'internal scaffold-based split validation ONLY' when no external dataset exists. The MUST plus escape hatch reads as self-contradictory; restate as conditional ('MUST if available, otherwise MUST document limitation and proceed with internal validation').
